items.title: Compatibility issues with Modern Keybindings and No More Useless Keys, Fabric 1.20.x
items.body: I'm noticing that in Fabric 1.20.x both No More Useless Keys (NMUK) and Modern Keybindings work with each other but don't function correctly when Controlling is also installed, and I wasn't sure which end the incompatibility was coming from so I posted in all three GitHub pages.

items.title: Feature: Allow double interactions
items.body:
Enable the use of things like 'shift + e' 'alt + b' etc.

Normally that will work, but if you also use e for something, and just press e, it will do both of them );

Or is this a thing of this mod? Sorry if so but it doesn't say so, feel like it would if so

- I see only mods for lower versions or there is a only fabric one I believe wit this, for 1.16.4/5 only
- They allow porting to forge

There link: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/amecs
Would be an amazing feature for all modpack makers on forge version, like myself!

items.title: Does not account for GUI scale setting
items.body: I usually set my GUI scale to 3, when I go into the controls with this mod installed, all the control names hang off the left side of the screen. (Reducing my GUI scale to 2 lets me see them all, but that's a workaround, not a fix.)

items.title: Can't Unbind Actions and Changing Keybind Types In Searchbar - 1.18.2-9.0+23
items.body:
In Vanilla Minecraft, you can unbind an action with the escape key. However, with Controlling installed (I'm using version 1.18.2-9.0+23), the escape key does nothing.

Additionally, if you search for a keybind and then change a keybind, as the search bar still thinks you are typing, it will edit the text in the searchbox, which, while not terrible, is mildly inconvinient.

(I'm new to GitHub, so if I made this comment wrong, let me know).

items.title: Version Incompatibility
items.body:
1.21.8 released but the 1.21.7 build has a hardcoded limit to not work unless the game is 1.21.7

Since 99% of mods from 1.21.6 work in 1.21.7 and 1.21.8, I recommend setting the minecraft version range in the fabric mod json to "~1.21.6" which will make it work in 1.21.6-1.21.8 same jar

items.title: Do not show key bind duplicates from debug menu
items.body: This is a very annoying "feature". Vanilla game does not show a debug menu key bind as duplicate, because it is used only inside the debug menu. Please implement the same vanilla behavior.

items.title: Entering search bar causes issues
items.body:
When you enter the search bar, you can't leave it, making each key stroke being directed to it. This makes multiple binds impossible, including clearing the bind. 
The only workaround is changing Full-screen.

Fabric 1.18.2 9.0+23

items.title: Modifier keys cannot be bound on their own
items.body: Lshift is by default crouch, but you couldn't bind it to anything else without using it as a modifier while using this mod. Maybe add a feature where double tapping a modifier key sets it as the bind for something?

items.title: Searching for a key could be better
items.body:
It has been a gripe of mine for a while, but often the B key is used for multiple bindings and I have to fix that, but searching for`key:B` or `key:"B"` gives everything containing B, like mouse buttons and `Not Bound` especially the last one is really annoying in big modpacks.

I think two changes would fix this:

1. key searches should automatically exclude all the unbound things
2. using `key:"B"` should be exact matching only, so no matching backspace, mouse buttons, tab

For the last one I'm on the fence for including Ctrl+B, Shift+B etc, I think it's ok to include those, but maybe you want true exact matching so if you want to search for that it should be `key:"CTRL+B"`
